channel-navy.note: globals.css --primary (hsl 220 42% 30% = #2C426D) is a rounded approximation of this hex; hex is normative

parchment-cream.note: distinct from --background #FAF8F5 (warm white); both are real tokens

components.name: Gold CTA Button
components.css: .ds-btn-gold { background-color: #B8962E; color: #1B2A4A; font-family: Montserrat, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; height: 44px; padding: 0 32px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-gold:hover { background-color: #D4AD3C; } .ds-btn-gold:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #B8962E; outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-btn-gold:active { transform: scale(0.97); } }

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background-color: #1B2A4A; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: Montserrat, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #2C3E6B; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #B8962E; outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } }

components.name: Interactive Card
components.html:
360° client view

Households, policies, documents and history in one record.
components.css: .ds-card { background-color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid rgba(27,42,74,0.10); border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; transition: border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-card:hover { border-color: rgba(184,150,46,0.40); box-shadow: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(27,42,74,0.05); } .ds-card h3 { font-family: Montserrat, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: #1B2A4A; margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-card p { font-family: Montserrat, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: rgba(27,42,74,0.60); margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; }

narrative.overview: Vigilant navy carries structure and daily work; gold is reserved for the single decisive action; crimson appears only when something is at stake. One typeface (Montserrat) at every register, motion spent on first-visit surfaces and denied to daily ones.
rules: The One Gold Rule: one gold action per screen.
The Crimson Reserve: crimson signals stakes, never decoration.
